description: This file defines the CatalogItem class, an entity representing individual catalog items in the eShop web application's core domain. It includes properties such as Name, Description, Price, PictureUri, CatalogTypeId, and CatalogBrandId, and methods to update these details, ensuring data integrity through guard clauses.

classes.name: CatalogItem
classes.description: Entity class representing a catalog item, including properties for item details and methods for updating these details.

methods.name: CatalogItem
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a new CatalogItem with specified type, brand, description, name, price, and picture URI.

methods.name: UpdateDetails
methods.description: Updates the catalog item properties with data from CatalogItemDetails, using guard clauses for validation.

methods.name: UpdatePictureUri
methods.description: Sets the PictureUri property; if input is null or empty, resets to an empty string; otherwise, constructs a path with a timestamp.

methods.name: CatalogItemDetails
methods.description: Record struct encapsulating details for updating a CatalogItem, including optional Name and Description, and the Price.
